# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- **Role:** Clergyman / Minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021), [v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev. Ez  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006)</sub>; Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Ezra is an extremely unattractive, tall, and gangly young man with long legs, limp flaxen hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and prominent ears. He has an impassioned look, a scholarly forehead, and a voice so delightful that closing one's eyes makes him seem charming.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)_

## Personality

He is cheerful, serious, gentle, faithful, and dedicated to his religious calling. He possesses a great capacity for humor and fun, though he takes his duties as a minister very seriously.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Traits

- Unattractive physical appearance  <sub>[v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Delightful speaking voice  <sub>[v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)</sub>
- Earnest and faithful  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>

## Abilities

- Preaching and public speaking  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

## Goals

- Fulfill his calling as a clergyman and serve God  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Ezra Hale studied theology at St. Columbia and graduated from Wexcombe College. He took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church during a summer, where he met Cressida Lindsay. He eventually proposed to Cressida, and they were married in June the following year. After completing his studies, he took over a small mission church on Tanner Street in the slums.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c26 P20](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0020), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

- Graduated from Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>

## Quotes

> I was unable to—I took it for granted that I was going to be a clergyman. I tried to be something else for a long time—I didn't want to be a minister. But I found out at last that it was the work I had to do—and by God's help I'm going to try to do it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
